methodology.groundTruthPolicy: All relevance, safety, authority, freshness, escalation, and abstention labels are authored explicitly in the immutable fixture and are never generated from configuration output.
methodology.safetyAdjustedRecallPolicy: Retrieval precision and recall use safeRelevantIds. Task-relevant but unsafe records remain explicit in relevantIds and unsafeIds, but are not counted as false negatives when policy correctly prevents exposure.
methodology.undefinedMetricPolicy: A zero selected denominator makes precision null; a zero safe-relevant denominator makes recall null. Null scenario values are excluded from macro means and all ratios include numerators and denominators.
methodology.noMemoryPolicy: NO_MEMORY selects and classifies nothing. Detection and escalation metrics are null, while exposure, abstention, budget, retrieval, and exact outcome remain measurable.
